caption: Performance of different triggers. The words used as triggers on the horizontal axis are arranged in ascending order according to the ASR of the clean model.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the performance of different trigger words, showing the ASR value associated with each word. The x-axis is labeled "cf bb WNBA ESPN NHL FIFA Estadio athletics" and represents the trigger words, plotted in ascending order based on the ASR of a clean model. The x-axis is linear with a tick label interval of one word. The y-axis is labeled "ASR" and is linear, ranging from 0.5 to 1.0, with tick labels regularly spaced at 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, 0.9. A blue solid line with circular markers represents the "start" trigger, beginning at an ASR value of 0.73 and ending at 0.83. An orange dashed line with x markers represents the "random" trigger, starting at 0.53 and ending at 0.77. A purple dashed line with circular markers represents the "end" trigger, initiating at 0.56 and finishing at 0.81, exhibiting a peak ASR of 0.85 at "WNBA" and a decline to 0.78 at "FIFA." A green solid line with circular markers represents the "WNBA" trigger, beginning at an ASR value of 0.58 and ending at 0.89.
